Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “one of the largest stars” by restricting the comparison to large main-sequence stars and excluding supergiants/hypergiants, which can have radii hundreds to thousands of times the Sun’s. This factual error led to the incorrect conclusion that the Sun would not be tiny next to the largest stars and thus the wrong selection of option A instead of the correct option B.
